text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since Wonder
Acute began cutting weight,
and her
running has already grown more refined as
a result.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been laser-focused during training,
eager to pick up new skills
she'll need for
the big race. One could easily mistake her
for a
post-debut runner. However...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I hear you. You can count on me!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Mm, I'm feeling great. Whatever drills you put me through, my body can keep up just fine.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now to hammer all these lessons home, I
think I'll go for another run
before the
morning's over. The big day's almost here,
so there's no
time to waste!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing no such thing. Now that I'm light
as a
feather—see?—nothing can bring me
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I return a nod, seeing how energetic she
looks, but deep down I'm
worried.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been doing well on her new training
regimen... too well, almost.
Her
single-minded dedication has led to
greater weight loss than I
planned for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime, I spot Wonder Acute eating
the bare minimum amount
of food allowed
by her regimen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she drops lower than her optimal race
weight, this whole thing will
backfire. I'm
about to tell her to eat her normal amount,
when...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Acute. Mind if I have a word
with you real quick? ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well I never! Falco wants to have a word with me? Is something the matter, darling?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's just—and sorry if this is
overstepping—but are you maybe on
a
diet right now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Your lunch is just so small I couldn't help
but notice. And you haven't
been eating
much for dinner at the dorm lately either.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong—as an Umadol, I like
to be mindful of how I look
too. But you
know, I don't think it's good to go too far
with a diet
either.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see now, you were just worried for me,
weren't you? I'm all right, just
getting into
shape for a race is all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, by a race, you mean the Tracen
Meet? Oh that's right, you're
running in
the dirt 2,000-meter too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... but Acute, you haven't had your
debut yet, right? I'd still be
worried about
pushing yourself too hard before you're
race-ready.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you see, if I want to get first, it's the
only way, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, there's a certain someone I
want to win for, so I'm going
to do
everything I can to do just that.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: To win... Right, of course.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Silly Falco! I know how much winning
means to me, but it completely
slipped my
mind that you'd feel the same way!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Forget what I said! ☆ We're rivals now!
And I won't settle for anything
less than
center stage either. Let's both give it all
we've got, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, let's. I'll make sure to get my body
into shape so I can run my
very best race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growwwl...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Look at you, already growling up a
storm so soon after eating.
Hang in there
just a little longer, okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Once the race is over, you can have all the
crunchy munchies you
want. Isn't that
right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to keep an eye on her from a
distance, but I guess I'm not as
sneaky as I
thought. An awkward smile greets me as I
show my face.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You really are the biggest worrywart
around. You were listening to my
little
chat with Falco too, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The big day's just around the
corner—nothing needs changing now.
I'm
only doing what I need to in order to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still don't get why she's pushing herself
so hard. Does the Tracen
Meet really mean
that much to her?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You see, I have a point to prove. I'm going
to show a certain someone
that they're not
"unfit to be a trainer" after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I... I'm unfit to be a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I... I'm unfit to be a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That day, when I saw you looking all tore
up, I couldn't just leave you
be. But ever
since you started helping me train, I've
been thinking...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just how many people like you are there?
A trainer willing to stay up
all night
working on a training plan for someone
who isn't even their
trainee.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
One willing to make tweaks to that plan
over and over again as we
grow. One who's
ready to devote so much of their time, all
of the
time, for our sakes...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now you tell me, how could someone like
that be unfit to be a
trainer? Just look how
much I've grown since working with
you—that's
all the evidence you need.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to prove it once and for all. If
I do well in this race, you'll
have no choice
but to recognize how wonderful a trainer
you are.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A win in this race would mean an awful lot
to someone I know. So no
matter what, I
need to earn this win for that someone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It never even occurred to me that I might be that someone. But thinking back to how we met, maybe it should come as no surprise.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose it's because you remind
me of someone.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You see, my daddy was a star boxer back
in his day, won Rookie of
the Year and
everything. But after that, he couldn't
quite find the
same success.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
He retired without any more big wins
under his belt, and ended up in
a dark
place for a spell. But with my momma's
support, he managed to
get back on his
feet.

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, Daddy did his fair share
of shameful things. But your
momma was
there for me. That's how I got back up.

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
So now, it's my turn to be there for
someone else. When life's trying
to knock
you down, having a pillar to lean on can
keep you on your
feet.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And now he's a role model—his boxing
gym is full of people looking
to regain
their footing in life just like him.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Growing up watching them, I learned to
always hold out a helping
hand where I
can. If there's a heart close to breaking, I
want to be the
brace holding it together.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I can save someone with my running,
then I'll run with all I have.
That's reason
enough to try my best, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Am I now? Flattery won't get you anything
but pickles, I'm afraid. And
besides...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling that says I can get stronger
and stronger yet. It tells
me I can push
myself harder, sharpen my skills even
further.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who planted this feeling in
me, you know? And it all
started because I
put my trust in you and worked to keep
up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, I want you to trust me too.
Mark my words, I'll prove to
you just how
amazing of a person you are!
